title: agrostis pilosa var. aristata
intro: Agrostis pilosa var. aristata, commonly known as aristate bentgrass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis pilosa var. aristata include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
